# IronBuddy: Nutrition Tracker

> IronBuddy: Nutrition Tracker is an offline calorie and macro tracker for Android, made for people who train. Meals are logged three ways: a photo of the plate (the dish is recognised on the phone and the user picks the portion and any extra oil), a barcode (about a million packaged products are built into the app), or the food search with grams from a kitchen scale (about 12,000 foods and dishes from USDA, FNDDS and CIQUAL). Every number is marked Exact (measured) or Estimate (with a range). It sets a daily calorie and protein target for goals including lose fat, build muscle, and a weekly check-in suggests a new target from the user's own logs and weigh-ins. There is no account, no ads and no analytics; data stays on the phone. Free to download with a 7-day free trial, then a one-time purchase through Google Play (Google Play shows the price for each country).

Key facts:

- Platform: Android, on Google Play. Not available on iPhone yet.
- Android package: com.ironbuddy.nutrition
- Google Play: coming soon
- Works offline: yes (food search, barcodes and photo recognition need no connection)
- Account required: no
- Ads: none. Analytics: none
- Subscription: none
- Free trial: The 7-day free trial includes everything: photo logging, barcodes, the food search, your plan, Today, My meals, weight and the weekly check-in. Buying the app once keeps everything unlocked after the trial, and adds the backup file, export and import of your data, share cards, the export for a coach, a customizable Today and accent colours. If you don't buy, the app becomes read-only when the trial ends: nothing is deleted and your meals stay visible, but logging and editing need the purchase.
- Price: a one-time purchase after the 7-day free trial; Google Play shows the amount for each country
- Developer: IronBuddy, also makers of IronBuddy: Workout Tracker (https://workout.ironbuddy.fit)
- Contact: iron.buddy.app@gmail.com
